meta.purpose: Acquisition register for upstream PRIMARY/RAW data of the cited cohorts.
meta.reason: Data hosts unreachable in build env (HTTP 403; PyPI-only allowlist). Locators recalled offline and flagged unverified.

datasets.data_type: Individual cohort records + DS02R1 dosimetry; dose-response tables
datasets.access_locator: rerf.or.jp (Open Data / formal data-request & research agreement)
datasets.notes: Some aggregated dose-response data are downloadable; individual-level data require a RERF research agreement.

datasets.data_type: Individual fallout-dose + mortality records
datasets.custodian: Kazakh Research Institute for Radiation Medicine & Ecology / German BfS (consortium)
datasets.access_locator: by collaboration with the cohort custodians (no public portal)
datasets.notes: Not publicly distributed; access by research collaboration.

datasets.data_type: Cohort mortality/incidence study data; water-distribution modeling outputs
datasets.access_locator: atsdr.cdc.gov (Camp Lejeune studies); data request / FOIA to ATSDR
datasets.notes: Study reports and water-modeling reports are public; analytic datasets via ATSDR request/FOIA.

datasets.data_type: Veteran mortality records; DoD plume-exposure models
datasets.custodian: U.S. Dept. of Veterans Affairs / DoD; GAO (plume review)
datasets.access_locator: VA Epidemiology; GAO report GAO-04-159 (gao.gov) is OPEN
datasets.notes: Veteran microdata restricted; plume-model review document is public.

datasets.data_type: Deployed vs non-deployed cancer-incidence cohort
datasets.custodian: London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine / King's College (MRC-funded)
datasets.access_locator: via the study team (no public portal)
datasets.notes: Cohort data held by the original investigators.

datasets.source_cluster: Agent Orange / dioxin (Ranch Hand; NIOSH; Seveso)
datasets.data_type: Air Force Health Study (Ranch Hand) cohort; NIOSH dioxin-worker cohort; Seveso cohort
datasets.custodian: NAS Medical Follow-up Agency (AFHS repository); NIOSH; Italian Seveso registry
datasets.access_locator: nationalacademies.org Medical Follow-up Agency (AFHS data); NIOSH; Seveso custodians
datasets.notes: AFHS data deposited with NAS/MFUA on application; others restricted.

datasets.data_type: VA Airborne Hazards & Open Burn Pit (AH-OBP) Registry; presumptive policy
datasets.access_locator: VA AH-OBP Registry (research data request); PACT Act = DOCUMENT
datasets.notes: Registry data via VA application; the Act itself and NASEM report are documents.

datasets.data_type: Community health-survey records; cytogenetic study data
datasets.access_locator: Sambhavna Trust (sambhavna.org); ICMR
datasets.notes: Grey-literature survey data; access via the holding organizations.

datasets.data_type: Household cancer/birth survey; hair-metal assays
datasets.access_locator: IJERPH 2010 article + its supplementary material (open access)
datasets.notes: Summary survey data are in the open-access papers; raw forms with authors.

datasets.data_type: Kuwait national cancer-registry incidence; thesis survey
datasets.custodian: Kuwait Cancer Control Center / Kuwait Cancer Registry; Univ. of Washington (thesis)
datasets.access_locator: UW ResearchWorks (Cange 2013 thesis, OPEN); KCCC registry via application
datasets.notes: Thesis is openly available; registry microdata via KCCC ethics approval.

datasets.data_type: Air-quality / PM measurements; review syntheses
datasets.access_locator: the cited journal articles + their supplements
datasets.notes: Immature latency; only measurement/review data exist so far.

datasets.data_type: Measured VOC concentrations; modeled air-toxics cancer-risk surfaces
datasets.custodian: U.S. EPA (AirToxScreen/NATA, ECHO, EJScreen); study authors
datasets.access_locator: epa.gov AirToxScreen + ECHO + EJScreen (OPEN); Robinson 2025 PNAS supplement
datasets.notes: EPA air-toxics surfaces are openly downloadable; measured-VOC data in the PNAS supplement.

datasets.data_type: Registry incidence/survival; PROPOSED-study microdata (region-year-age-sex-site)
datasets.custodian: Saudi Ministry of Health — Saudi Cancer Registry / Saudi Health Council
datasets.access_locator: SCR annual reports (public PDFs, aggregate); microdata via MoH ethics + DUA
datasets.notes: THE key input to the proposed study (Section 5). Aggregate reports are public; case-level microdata require Saudi MoH ethics approval.

datasets.data_type: Monitoring-site SO2/PM/CO/H2S/NOx concentrations, 1991
datasets.access_locator: tables within the cited 1994 article
datasets.notes: Historical monitoring values reported in the paper; raw station logs likely not archived.

datasets.data_type: Region-level cancer counts + spatial weights (Moran's I)
datasets.access_locator: IJERPH 2013 article + supplement (open access)
datasets.notes: Aggregate inputs are in the open-access paper.

datasets.data_type: Global Adult Tobacco Survey microdata + report
datasets.custodian: WHO / CDC Global Tobacco Surveillance System (GTSS)
datasets.access_locator: who.int tobacco surveillance + CDC GTSSData (microdata on request); report OPEN
datasets.notes: Country report is public; respondent-level microdata via GTSS data request.

datasets.data_type: Trial/service-screening incidence + lead-time models
datasets.access_locator: the cited journal articles (estimates + parameters in-text/supplements)
datasets.notes: Used for the breast-cancer exclusion rationale; trial microdata not public.

datasets.data_type: Pooled miner cohorts (radon dose-response)
datasets.access_locator: PUMA consortium custodians; BEIR VI = DOCUMENT (nap.nationalacademies.org)
datasets.notes: Pooled cohort data are consortium-held; BEIR VI is a public report.

datasets.data_type: Population-based 5-year survival estimates
datasets.access_locator: published CONCORD-3 estimates (Lancet 2018 + appendices)
datasets.notes: Aggregate survival estimates published; contributing registry microdata restricted.

datasets.data_type: Modeling inputs (stem-cell divisions; extrinsic-fraction)
datasets.access_locator: Science 2017 + Nature 2016 supplementary data
datasets.notes: Supplementary datasets accompany both papers.
